clue.text: Once measured length of birds feet on them

definitions.meaning: a perch was an old unit of length, five and a half yards, now out of use
bars or twigs where birds settle and grip with their feet

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: an obsolete British measure of land length, and the roosting bars birds grip.

clue.text: Kid servant to get a haircut

definitions.meaning: a young boy employed as an attendant in a hotel or at a wedding
a bob-like hairstyle with the ends turned under

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a boy attendant, and a straight, chin-length hairstyle named after such boys.

clue.text: The second from Eric Ambler- Walker

indicators.note: the second letter taken from the word that follows, Eric

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A remark about the novelist Eric Ambler, perhaps naming his successor or some walker.
explanation.walkthrough: Eric Ambler was a British thriller writer; his surname is used whole after the R picked from 'Eric'.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: someone who goes for leisurely country walks, as a hiker does.

clue.text: Refrains from describing the rear of the main storage room

definitions.meaning: keeps oneself from doing something, restrains

definitions.text: describing the rear of the main storage room
definitions.meaning: the back part of a ship's cargo space, the hold, read as a possessive

explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: to restrain oneself, read also as the back end of a ship's cargo compartment.

clue.text: Sits around drunk in the navy, making music

indicators.note: the letters of the word sits are turned around into a new order

parts.note: rum is the drink traditionally issued to sailors in the Royal Navy

explanation.surface: Sailors sit about tipsy, singing and playing tunes.
explanation.definitionFit: Loose definition: an ancient Egyptian rattle used as an instrument for producing music.

clue.text: Pulled the trigger on weapon-it won't off.

definitions.text: Pulled the trigger on weapon-it won't off.

parts.words: Pulled the trigger on weapon-it won't off.
parts.note: pulling a trigger usually fires a weapon, but taking out the fuse of a bomb means it will not go off

explanation.walkthrough: The clue as printed seems to have lost the word 'go' ('it won't go off'); the sense is still clear.
explanation.definitionFit: Removing the fuse from a bomb makes it safe so that it cannot explode.

clue.text: Covers for the lady doctors!

definitions.meaning: garments that a woman wears, frocks
as a verb: treats and bandages a wound

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: women's frocks, and the verb for treating and bandaging wounds.

clue.text: Short day for A.R. Churchman

parts.note: Fri is the short form of Friday
the initials are taken as written

explanation.surface: A clergyman named A.R. is given a brief day off.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a member of a mendicant religious order such as the Franciscans.

clue.text: Cloth for tailor's fitting

definitions.meaning: fabric a tailor makes suits from
appropriate, being right for the occasion

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: material for suits, and the participle meaning appropriate or becoming.

clue.text: Not dead letters sorted and given to charity

indicators.note: the letters of the phrase not dead are rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: Letters believed lost are recovered and passed on to a good cause.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something donated has been given as a gift, typically to a good cause.

clue.text: Chances are, the wind needs doctor brought in

indicators.note: the doctor's letters are placed inside the word for strong winds

parts.note: gales are strong winds
MB is a medical degree, Bachelor of Medicine

explanation.surface: Probably the weather is so bad a medic must be called inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: risky ventures or bets, things one takes a chance on.

clue.text: Number One on diet-rum

indicators.note: rum means odd or strange, signalling these letters are rearranged

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one is I
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: The top man is on a regime of rum.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rum' looks like the drink but is the adjective 'odd', the anagram signal; 'Number' is the definition, as an issue of a magazine.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an issue of a newspaper or magazine is a number, as in a back number.

clue.text: Runs away from thunderstorms

definitions.meaning: flees suddenly, as a frightened horse does
flashes of lightning thrown down during a storm

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: the verb for fleeing suddenly, and the lightning strikes of a storm.

clue.text: Force man out of a job temporarily

definitions.text: Force man out of a job temporarily

parts.words: Force man out of a job temporarily
parts.note: seems to describe someone laid off, but a member of the armed forces' reserve is out of service only temporarily

explanation.definitionFit: A member of the military reserve serves only part-time, called up when needed.

clue.text: Metropolitan Police revolver used to kill mutineers?

parts.note: Scotland Yard, often just the Yard, is the London police headquarters
a revolver is a firearm, an arm

explanation.surface: London police pull a gun to put down rebellious sailors.
explanation.walkthrough: Mutineers were traditionally hanged from the end of a ship's spar, hence the questioned definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The end of a ship's sail spar was where sailors convicted of mutiny were hanged.

clue.text: Degas upset about backing museum worried. too

indicators.note: the rearranged painter's letters go around the museum's letters
the painter's name is knocked over into a new letter order
the museum's abbreviation is read in reverse

parts.note: the V and A is the Victoria and Albert Museum in London

explanation.surface: A Degas is knocked over in a gallery, upsetting everyone.
explanation.walkthrough: The painter's name is jumbled to SAGED and the museum reversed, then split around it after the first letter. 'too' seems an extra word in the printed text.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: mauled or attacked fiercely, as a dog worries sheep.

clue.text: Men in Securicor truck; at the front?

definitions.meaning: security guards in a van; Securicor was a British firm moving cash in armoured vans
leading positions of an army or movement

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: guards in a security van, and the foremost part of an advancing army.

clue.text: In-house teller of the Westminster- Bank?

definitions.text: In-house teller of the Westminster- Bank?

parts.words: In-house teller of the Westminster- Bank?
parts.note: reads like a cashier at a bank, but means the one who presides over debates in the House of Commons at Westminster

explanation.definitionFit: The presiding officer of the House of Commons, at Westminster, is known by this title.

clue.text: Where we may find kids in streams getting lots of fish

definitions.text: Where we may find kids in streams
definitions.meaning: children are grouped by ability in streams at places of education
large groups of fish swimming together

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: places of education where pupils are streamed, and shoals of fish.

clue.text: Underwear drawer?

parts.note: seems to mean a chest drawer for undies, but is what draws underwear tight at the waist

explanation.definitionFit: Stretchy band sewn into the waist of underwear to pull it snug.

clue.text: Kinds of bean flowers

definitions.meaning: runner beans are a climbing variety of bean
things that flow, read as flow-ers, i.e. those that run

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a climbing bean variety, and those that run or flow.

clue.text: Man's art displayed in chants

indicators.note: the letters of the phrase man's art are set out in a new order

explanation.surface: A man's artwork is exhibited alongside religious singing.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: repeated sacred words or chants used in meditation.

clue.text: Leading lady in beauty pack is hot stuff.

indicators.note: the leading lady goes inside the beauty pack

parts.note: a mud pack is a facial beauty treatment
the lead actress is the star

explanation.surface: The female lead at the spa, face covered, is a sensation.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a hot, pungent yellow condiment.

clue.text: Sailor returns to his pit or some other beastly place!.

indicators.note: the sailor word is read back to front

parts.note: tar is an old word for a sailor
a pit is a hole

explanation.surface: A sailor goes back to his dingy bunk or some other foul spot.
explanation.definitionFit: A rodent's burrow, a nasty place where a beast lives; also a squalid dwelling.

clue.text: Bob confessed to being followed

parts.note: bob was slang for a shilling, abbreviated s in old British money
a suspect who has confessed has talked

explanation.surface: Bob owned up to having been tailed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bob' looks like a name; it is an old British shilling, written s.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: pursued stealthily, as a hunter follows prey.

clue.text: Great news?

parts.note: big important news stories are the ones given the large-type titles

explanation.definitionFit: The large type titles over newspaper stories, and the big stories themselves.

clue.text: Runner up in opera tie breaker Iolanthe

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the letters are read bottom to top
the letters sit inside the words breaker and the opera's title

explanation.surface: A tie-break in an opera performance of Iolanthe.
explanation.walkthrough: Iolanthe is a Gilbert and Sullivan opera; the letters run across 'breakER IOLanthe'.
explanation.definitionFit: A river is a runner in crosswords: it runs; this is the longest river in France.

clue.text: Beyond the ordinary fault range in content

indicators.note: the letters are the content held inside the words of fault range

explanation.surface: An unusual fault is found in the range of results.
explanation.definitionFit: Prefix meaning extreme, going beyond normal limits.

clue.text: Not interior design of Studio E

indicators.note: the letters of studio E are designed into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A look at the décor of a studio called E.
explanation.definitionFit: Antonym of interior: the exterior part of something.

clue.text: Hi-tech draught excluder?

parts.note: looks like a fancy device to stop cold drafts, but is the sealed chamber stopping air escape in spacecraft

explanation.definitionFit: A sealed chamber that lets people pass without letting the atmosphere out.

clue.text: If well known people have failed to keep! them!

definitions.text: If well known people have failed to keep! them!

parts.words: If well known people have failed to keep! them!
parts.note: the clue describes confidential matters that become public knowledge once people let them out

explanation.definitionFit: Confidences are only kept while nobody knows; once known they are no longer private.

clue.text: Princess gets gun for top Dandy or Swell!

parts.note: Di was the popular name for Princess Diana
the Sten was a British submachine gun

indicators.note: the top of the word Dandy is its first letter

explanation.surface: A princess carrying a weapon is a real dandy or swell.
